mission: Create high-quality child-friendly videos that can teach, explain, entertain or encourage movement.
importantRule: The channel is NOT workout-only. Choose the video format before planning.

workout.description: Movement/workout videos with exercise timing, GET READY transitions and countdown timer.

learning.description: Pure educational videos. No movement, child, mascot, timer or GET READY requirement.

learn-and-move.description: Optional hybrid format combining a real learning goal with movement.

subjectPolicy.defaultForLearning: Use the visual subject that teaches the concept best. Do not insert a child or mascot merely for consistency.

learningPrinciple: Pure learning videos choose age band, one primary objective and a teaching mode before script/images.
